title: 10 million dollarlik xarid 20 yildan keyin nimaga aylandi?
hook: U 10 million dollarni zarar ko'rayotgan studiyaga tikdi.

scenes.text: 1986 yilda bir tadbirkor Lucasfilm'ning kichik grafika bo'limiga taxminan 10 million dollar sarfladi.
Studiya yillar davomida zarar ko'rdi, lekin u uni yopmadi.
scenes.keywords: empty office at night single desk lamp

scenes.text: Bu Stiv Jobs va Pixar edi. 1995 yilda Pixar to'liq kompyuterda chizilgan birinchi film, Toy Story'ni chiqardi.
2006 yilda Disney Pixar'ni 7,4 milliard dollarlik aksiyalarga sotib oldi.
Ba'zan sabr eng katta sarmoya bo'ladi.
scenes.keywords: small plant growing from soil time lapse

description:
1986 yilda Stiv Jobs Lucasfilm'ning kompyuter grafikasi bo'limini sotib oldi va unga kapital kiritdi; jami sarf taxminan 10 million dollar edi. Bo'lim Pixar nomini oldi. 2006 yilda Disney Pixar'ni 7,4 milliard dollarlik aksiyalar evaziga sotib oldi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search). Jobs spun the Graphics Group out of Lucasfilm in Feb 1986; the roughly $10M figure is the total: about $5M paid to Lucasfilm plus about $5M put in as capital (ABC News reports only the $5M price, so scene 1 now says 'sarfladi', not 'sotib oldi 10 million dollarga'). Pixar lost money for years while Jobs funded it. Toy Story (1995) was the first fully computer-animated feature film (Britannica, D23). Disney's all-stock purchase was announced 24 Jan 2006, valued at about $7.4 billion. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pixar ; https://www.britannica.com/topic/Toy-Story ; https://d23.com/a-to-z/toy-story-film ; https://ingest.abcnews.com/blogs/technology/2011/10/steve-jobs-the-pixar-years/
